verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a background jobs framework for long-running tasks with no timeouts, automatic retries with exponential backoff, and recurring cron schedules that can be managed from the dashboard. Users independently confirm the scheduled tasks "just work" and that jobs run without ongoing attention. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of an AI assistant setting up and deploying these automations end-to-end on its own; automations are written in code rather than configured directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Trigger.dev is an open source background jobs framework that lets you write reliable workflows in plain async code. Run long-running AI tasks, handle complex background jobs
A task that is triggered on a recurring schedule using cron syntax.
Create, activate, disable, edit and delete schedules in the dashboard without having to deploy any new code.
This task will retry 10 times with exponential backoff.
The scheduled task feature has been a lifesaver—super simple and just works exactly as expected.
Trigger spinning up jobs was perfect and we migrated in a day and now I never think about it.
